truth_boundary: Neither full algorithm nor regret/BAI complexity bound is proved. Estimation tails remain a missing producer. Novelty and optimality are unresolved; classical multi-fidelity and recent quantum papers are explicit prior art. No quantum advantage is claimed by this launch. Fixed-n basis-only information, natural T, two-environment cost and prior seal/Windows admission boundaries remain visible. Research release does not merge main.
